policy.default_rule: exclude unless the licence, immutable revision, permitted split, and verification path are explicit
policy.candidate_warehouse_rule: registry or candidate-warehouse presence is not training authorisation; prohibited and evaluation-only sources are registry metadata only and contribute no warehouse rows
policy.sft_eligibility_rule: an SFT row must have warehouse split=train, come from an enabled source and allowed original source split, and pass provenance, verification, deduplication, canonical-task multiplicity, and holdout gates; it is authorized only when the immutable warehouse row is natively training_eligible=true or a separate exact-row approval receipt binds the warehouse fingerprint, row ID, content hash, reviewer attestation, and rubric artifact hash to an approved decision
policy.protected_exam_boundary: without a written grant, WAEC, CheetahWAEC, MySchoolGist/JAMB, and ALOC may inform only independently worded high-level taxonomies; actual source text or media may enter neither the warehouse, SFT, nor evaluation. A permissioned ingest defaults to a quarantined evaluation-only set; training requires an additional explicit training and artifact-distribution grant

sources.name: Muta verified STEM generators v2
sources.verification: full deterministic row regeneration plus exact-arithmetic/unit recomputation and pedagogy-specific response checks, including answer withholding for Socratic rows
sources.notes: Original MIT-licensed West-African-context questions from the Muta repository; only independently normalized topic taxonomies are used and no protected WAEC/JAMB wording is copied.

sources.name: TemplateGSM
sources.verification: binds a source-text-free exhaustive audit of the pinned templategsm-2000-1k configuration; quarantines every template with any observed static-filter failure; rechecks each surviving row for a finite canonical result, terminal target support, float artifacts, and exact numeric-only equality contradictions; never parses or executes publisher solution code and does not independently solve the prompt
sources.notes: Use only the pinned templategsm-2000-1k configuration and its hash-bound templategsm_filter_audit.json. Release warehouse builds require the authenticated local 2,000-file snapshot and record that no network was used for row materialization. The full scan quarantines every failing template before row emission, and the defensive row filter remains active. Configurations are nested subsets, not independent data. Every surviving selected row remains training-ineligible until an exact-row human audit receipt approves it.

sources.taxonomy_eval_boundary: Unlicensed use is limited to independently worded high-level topic, skill, rubric-structure, and error-category labels. No question, answer, marking scheme, report prose, screenshot, OCR, figure, or close paraphrase enters the warehouse, SFT, or evaluation. If WAEC grants evaluation rights, ingest into a separate temporally held-out evaluation-only store; training remains prohibited unless the grant explicitly authorizes it.
sources.permission_route: Obtain a written licence directly from WAEC identifying countries, years, subjects, papers, solutions, figures, automated retrieval/OCR, storage, evaluation, training, derived datasets, adapter/weight distribution, territory, duration, and attribution. Record the executed grant and hashes before changing this registry entry.
sources.notes: All source items remain excluded. Only independently normalized taxonomy labels may guide original generation until a written WAEC grant is recorded.

sources.taxonomy_eval_boundary: Unlicensed use is limited to independently worded high-level topic and format labels. No past-paper wording, explanation, answer, screenshot, OCR, figure, close paraphrase, or site-derived item enters the warehouse, SFT, or evaluation. A permissioned ingest defaults to a separate evaluation-only store; training requires an explicit additional grant.
sources.permission_route: Obtain written permission from CheetahWAEC for its explanations and automated site access, plus separate written clearance from WAEC or each relevant underlying exam rightsholder for paper content. sources.notes: Terms prohibit scraping, harvesting, or mass downloading when it harms the site or other users, reserve original explanations, and grant no model-training reuse; CheetahWAEC cannot by itself license third-party exam rights it does not own.

sources.name: MySchoolGist JAMB past-question downloads and CBT content
sources.approx_rows: 12 downloadable subjects; site advertises 30,000+ app questions
sources.verification: site disclaims accuracy and is not JAMB
sources.taxonomy_eval_boundary: Unlicensed use is limited to independently worded high-level JAMB subject, topic, and item-format labels. No PDF/app question, answer, explanation, screenshot, OCR, figure, close paraphrase, or site-derived item enters the warehouse, SFT, or evaluation. A permissioned ingest defaults to a separate evaluation-only store; training requires an explicit additional grant.
sources.permission_route: Obtain written permission from MySchoolGist for consultant-created content and automated retrieval, plus separate written clearance from JAMB or each relevant underlying rightsholder for exam items. The grant must separately state evaluation, training, permanent storage, derived-dataset, adapter, and model-weight distribution rights.
sources.notes: Free download is access permission, not a bulk-reproduction or model-training licence. The download page carries a copyright footer; the app policy separately says MySchoolGist owns the software and that education consultants create app content, but does not establish chain-of-title for every JAMB PDF. An official JAMB brochure notice requires written permission for reproduction, transmission, or retrieval-system storage of that publication; it is evidence of publication practice, not a claim governing every past paper. No official open question-data or ML-training grant was located in the 2026-09-16 review.

sources.name: ALOC Station Questions API
sources.license: Proprietary; standard API terms prohibit AI training and bulk mirroring
sources.approx_rows: API advertises WAEC, JAMB, NECO, Post-UTME, and state-board questions
sources.verification: API answer keys are supplied as-is and require independent subject review
sources.taxonomy_eval_boundary: Do not issue authenticated extraction requests for Muta under the standard terms. No API question, option, answer, passage, metadata, explanation, screenshot, close paraphrase, or derived row enters the warehouse, SFT, or evaluation. Public documentation may support only independently worded high-level source taxonomy.
sources.permission_route: Obtain a signed bespoke agreement from ALOC that expressly overrides the standard 48-hour cache limit, permanent cold-mirroring prohibition, systematic cursor-traversal prohibition, and AI-model training/evaluation/benchmark ban for the named Muta project. The agreement must authorize a server-side bulk export or documented retrieval method, permanent offline storage, fine-tuning, derived transformations, competition submission, adapter/merged-model/weight distribution, attribution, territory, duration, deletion/termination treatment, and the exact exam bodies, years, subjects, fields, and countries. Require ALOC to identify its authority or upstream grants for the historical exam content and any separate exam-body clearance needed.
sources.notes: ALOC Terms v2.3.0 sections 4, 6, and 8 permit only short operational caching under standard plans, prohibit permanent wholesale synchronization, prohibit systematic cursor crawling, and expressly ban using API responses or questions to train, fine-tune, evaluate, or benchmark an LLM or neural network. The terms mention a separate annual enterprise bulk-dataset licence for offline deployments, but that statement does not itself override the AI-training ban. User-supplied API keys were not used, tested, stored, or committed; this source contributes zero rows.
